classification.difficultyReason: Clear the nested reciprocal fraction with multiplier x.

answer.short:
$\frac{1-x}{1+x}$, $x\ne0,-1$.

Multiply the numerator and denominator by $x$.
answer.worked:
Multiply the numerator and denominator by their common denominator, $x$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\frac1x-1}{\frac1x+1}&=\frac{x\left(\frac1x-1\right)}{x\left(\frac1x+1\right)}\\\frac{\frac1x-1}{\frac1x+1}&=\frac{1-x}{1+x}\end{align*}$$
Original domain: $x\ne0,-1$.
